rules.description: REGRESSION, FreeCAD 1.0 -> 1.1. Body001 loses roughly 69% of its volume: 14113.476 mm3 in 0.20, 0.21 and 1.0, then 4308.973 mm3 from 1.1 onward (still 4308.973 in 1.1.3). Surface area falls 12203.795 -> 4008.865 and the bounding box loses its whole upper Y extent (y_max 67.45 -> -45). The recompute reports no error and no invalid shape, so this is a silent geometry loss. Baselined against its native 0.21 deliberately, so the suite will report this as fixed the moment the volume returns. Weekly-bisected 2026-08-03: the history is not monotone. Body001 is NULL (fully invalid, no metrics) in every weekly from 2025.04.21 through 2025.09.24, then becomes valid-but-short from the 2025.10.01 weekly onward -- so the 69% figure dates from the 2025-09-24 -> 2025-10-01 window, very likely PR #24256 (e77f181393, Part Boolean Refine default), while the original break to NULL happened between the 1.0 branch point and 2025.04.21, a stretch of main with no archived weeklies. See Data/RegressionCandidates.md.
Same 1.0 -> 1.1 regression as the solids rule, seen through the partdesign_bodies section.
Same regression at its source: Pad006 yields 3 disjoint solids from FreeCAD 1.1 onward where it produced 1 through 1.0. The fragmentation of this pad is what drops Body001's volume.
